QuestInfo.name: Uninvited Guest
QuestInfo.0: There was a report that that the strange Teddy Bear that was showing up around Fantasy Theme World was also seen at the Fantasy Crittertorium show. Find that white bear!
QuestInfo.1: Find out who that weird white bear was that showed up in the Fantasy Crittertorium.
QuestInfo.2: That strange bear was Spiegelmann! He said he was just visiting, but something fishy's going on...

0.0: Psst! Hey! Hehehe... What?! Didn't think you'd see me here, huh? Wanna know what I'm up to?

yes.0: This suit is HOT. Give me a sec to mop the sweat off my brow.

no.0: Hey, whatever works for you. I've got spyin' work to do!

1.0: I'm having a GREAT time at this park. It's way less of a dump-heap than I was expecting. I just brought the bear suit to fit in. When in Rome, you know? The ladies seem to like it.
1.1: So a few rides end up broken. And SURE there was some white fur up there, but there's LOTS of white bears wandering around here. How about you just take this little souvenir I bought and forget you eeeeever saw your favorite friend at this park?

yes.0: In fact, if anybody asks, I was skiing. In lava. And I fought a dragon and won and everybody was super impressed. Yeah, that sounds pretty believable.
